cost.model: T >= T_comp, T >= T_mem, T >= T_comp + T_mem if P = 0

terms.T_mem: DRAM traffic / bandwidth with A re-read per column block and B per row block

program:
for each block (i, j):
  for u in 0 .. P-1:   load k-tile u -> slot u mod S
  for p in 0 .. KT-1:                     # KT = ceil(K/Tk)
    if p+P < KT:       load k-tile p+P -> slot (p+P) mod S
    barrier                               # leading
    compute C[i,j] += slot (p mod S)
    if beta: barrier                      # trailing
backward_map: forget the grid, the slots and the schedule => C = A B over (M, N, K)

certificate_schema.relation: slot (u mod S) holds A[:,u], B[u,:] from the completion of its load until the last read of k-tile u
certificate_schema.rank: number of k-tiles not yet consumed

obligations.name: coverage
obligations.meaning: every output index of each dimension lies in some admitted tile

obligations.name: exact_once
obligations.meaning: no two admitted (tile, offset) pairs denote the same in-range index

obligations.name: no_phantom
obligations.meaning: no admitted (tile, offset) consumes or writes an index >= extent

obligations.name: readiness
obligations.scope: all interleavings of the event model
obligations.meaning: a warp reads a slot only after every write of the tile it consumes

obligations.name: lifetime
obligations.scope: all interleavings of the event model
obligations.meaning: no slot element is overwritten between its defining write and its last read

obligations.name: agreement
obligations.meaning: a replayed execution yields exactly the reference tokens A[i,k]*B[k,j]

structure.name: bottleneck_dominance
structure.move: epigraph cost T >= max(T_comp, T_mem); search the tile menu with prefetch overlap
structure.obligation: the dominant resource stays dominant across the feasible region of the menu

rationale: Listing 1 of the paper. Shared-memory staging with S rotating slots and prefetch distance P; the lifetime precondition P <= S - 2 + beta is the weakest one on the checked family (24/24).
